title: Yellow Spicy Dutch Natto Stew
description: A spicy and dense one-pot Dutch dish featuring natto, lardons-render, and shojin-friendly ingredients, this stew is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Render the lardons in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pot and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add the natto, vegetable broth, potatoes, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Return the lardons to the pot and stir to combine.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
